app.title: LightPen
app.tagline: Write on PDFs in the air

viewer.dropHint: Drop a PDF here, or use Open PDF
viewer.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected and cannot be opened.
viewer.corrupt: This file could not be read as a PDF. It may be corrupt.
viewer.tooLarge: This PDF is too large to open (max 200 MB).
viewer.unknown: This PDF could not be opened. It may be damaged or unsupported.
viewer.crashTitle: Something went wrong while rendering this PDF.

camera.privacy: All video processing happens on this device. No frames ever leave your device.
camera.rationaleBody: LightPen uses your camera to track your hand so you can write in the air. Nothing is recorded or uploaded. The camera is only on while tracking is active.
camera.denied: Camera permission was denied. Check your system camera settings and close any other app using the camera, then try again — on Linux/Arch (CachyOS), make sure your user is in the 'video' group and log back in after adding it. You can still draw with your mouse or finger.
camera.notFound: No camera was found. Check that one is connected.
camera.inUse: The camera is in use by another app. Close it and try again.
camera.unsupported: Camera is not supported here. You can still draw manually.
camera.hintTooFar: Your hand looks far away — move closer.
camera.hintTooClose: Your hand looks too close — move back a little.
camera.hintLowLight: Low light detected — try a brighter spot.
camera.hintOutOfFrame: Hand out of frame — move it into view.
camera.modelMissing: Hand-tracking model not found. Run `npm run fetch:model` or reinstall the app.
camera.noCapturePlugins: The camera could not be opened because the video stack is missing. On Arch/CachyOS run: sudo pacman -S gst-plugins-good gst-plugin-pipewire. On Debian/Ubuntu run: sudo apt install gstreamer1.0-plugins-good gstreamer1.0-pipewire. Or use the AppImage, which bundles them. Then restart LightPen.
camera.failureNoFrames: The camera is open, but its frames are not reaching the tracker, so nothing can be detected. Close other camera apps and press Stop, then Start. On Linux an AppImage may lack the GStreamer capture plugins (Arch/CachyOS: sudo pacman -S gst-plugins-good gst-plugin-pipewire).
camera.failureDetectorError: The hand tracker is rejecting the camera frames, so your hand is never seen. Press Stop and Start again; if it persists, send the diagnostics line below with a bug report.
camera.failureNoHand: The camera works, but no hand has been found for a while. Keep your whole hand in frame, about arm's length away and well lit.

gestures.hover: Point with index finger to move the cursor
gestures.swipe: Swipe sideways with open palm for next/previous page
gestures.pause: Hold a fist for 1 second to pause tracking
gestures.pauseArt: A closed fist, an arrow to a clock, and a pause symbol: holding a fist for one second pauses tracking.
gestures.modeAir: Air mode: pinch to write, open palm to erase, swipe to change pages.
gestures.modeTouch: Touch mode: your index finger is the pointer, just like a phone.
gestures.touchPoint: Point with your index finger to move the cursor
gestures.touchDrag: Pinch and move to draw (or to erase, with the eraser tool)
gestures.touchTap: Quick pinch and release to tap without leaving ink
gestures.touchScroll: Two fingers up, then move them up or down to change pages
gestures.touchZoom: Two fingers up, then spread or close them to zoom
gestures.touchLongPress: Hold a still pinch for 1 second to pause tracking

tutorial.title: Welcome to LightPen
tutorial.welcome: Write on PDFs in the air with your hand. Everything runs on your device.
tutorial.privacy: Your camera video never leaves this device. No recording, no uploads, no tracking.
tutorial.permission: First, allow camera access so LightPen can see your hand.
tutorial.placement: Place your camera at eye level, about an arm's length away, in good light. Keep your hand inside the frame.
tutorial.placementDistance: About one arm's length from the camera.
tutorial.placementArt: Two camera setups: a camera level with your eyes, and a camera below your raised hand, which is harder to track.
tutorial.placementDistanceArt: A camera on the left, a dashed line to a person on the right, showing an arm's length of distance.
tutorial.calibration: Drag a box over the area where you will move your hand — that box becomes the page.
tutorial.calibrationHint: Comfort is more important than size: pick a box you can reach without stretching. You can redo this later from the tutorial.
tutorial.calibrationUnset: Nothing drawn yet — press Next to use the whole camera frame.
tutorial.exHover: Point your index finger at the page (hover).
tutorial.exWrite: Pinch thumb and index together to draw a line.
tutorial.exErase: Show an open palm over your line to erase it.
tutorial.exSwipe: Swipe sideways with an open palm.
tutorial.exPause: Hold a fist for one second.
tutorial.done: Great! You know all the gestures. Here is your cheat sheet.
tutorial.exTap: Quickly pinch and release — a tap, with no line left behind.
tutorial.exScroll: Raise two fingers and move them up or down to change page.
tutorial.exZoom: Raise two fingers, then spread or close them.
tutorial.exLongPress: Hold a still pinch for one second.
tutorial.doneTouch: Great! That is the phone vocabulary, with your hand as the finger. Here is your cheat sheet.
tutorial.practiceTouchHint: Practice with the mouse here: click and drag to draw, and the pinch, two-finger and long-press steps complete as you go.
tutorial.cameraOffPrompt: Turn on your camera to see your face, framing guide, and live hand skeleton here.
tutorial.faceGuideCaption: Center your face in the oval and raise your hand into view

settings.title: Settings
settings.calibrationSet: Current area: x {{x0}}–{{x1}}%, y {{y0}}–{{y1}}% of the camera frame.
settings.calibrationUnset: Not calibrated yet — the whole camera frame maps to the page.
settings.modeAirHelp: Air gestures: pinch thumb and index to write, show an open palm to erase, swipe sideways with an open palm to change pages, hold a fist to pause. No tool switching needed.
settings.modeTouchHelp: Touch gestures, the way a phone works: your index finger is the cursor, pinch-and-drag draws, a quick pinch is a tap, two fingers scroll and zoom, and a still pinch pauses. Erasing uses the toolbar's eraser, like a phone app.
settings.backendHelp: Hybrid uses your GPU for hand inference and CPU cores for frame preprocessing and ink smoothing. Detected: {{hardware}}.
